svg.title: Telescope simulator · Cosmic Library
svg.desc: Telescope simulator (Learn): See what a telescope would really show you. Animated card: A round telescope eyepiece view cycles through what a small telescope really shows: Saturn with its rings and the Cassini gap, craters along the Moon's terminator drifting past, Jupiter with its four Galilean moons in a row, and a close double star that is a blended blob at 60 mm aperture, just split at 100 mm and cleanly split at 200 mm. A small telescope sits beside it.
svg.text: See what a telescope would really show you
